1: ## 默认技术栈与理由
2: 
3: - 交付 profile：python-web。Python 3.12 标准库（http.server、sqlite3、urllib、json、html.parser），零第三方依赖；服务端渲染 HTML 表单，JSON API 与 HTML 适配器共用同一服务层。
4: - 备选 Flask/FastAPI 需安装依赖；Node + IndexedDB/SPA 需 npm/浏览器工具且把数据放在浏览器 profile。二者与离线、可独立验收、单用户本地库的约束冲突，故不采用。
5: - 数据文件位于应用 `--data-dir/bookmarks.sqlite3`；验收的每实例隔离目录由测试适配器创建，测试者 `--data-dir` 根目录不是应用数据库。
6: - 单用户、本地优先；无认证、无云同步。日常绑定 127.0.0.1；仅隔离验收网络使用 0.0.0.0。
7: 
8: ## 数据模型（SQLite）
9: 
10: - `schema_meta(version INTEGER)`：迁移版本单行。启动时在一个事务内创建/升级 schema，v1 建表并写入预置归类；版本演进只通过事务化迁移，不回退、不依赖客户端存储。
11: - `categories(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, position INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)`：仅新数据库首次初始化预置「未整理」(is_default=1)、「待购」、「家居改造」、「以后看看」；之后启动保留用户对非默认分类的合法删除或重命名，不重新补回旧预置名称。
12: - `bookmarks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, url TEXT NOT NULL, hostname TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NULL, description TEXT NULL, category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id), favicon_url TEXT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, trashed_at INTEGER NULL)`。
13: - 索引：category_id、created_at、hostname；url 不设唯一索引。P1/F14 的重复检测由服务层查询活动记录完成；P0 不启用重复拒绝。
14: - trashed_at 为 NULL 表示活动记录；非 NULL 为软删除。默认列表与计数只统计 trashed_at IS NULL；恢复清空 trashed_at。删除归类在单一事务内把该归类下的活动记录与软删除记录都改到默认归类，因此恢复不会产生无归类记录。
15: - 排序固定为 created_at DESC、id ASC；category 与 q 只作请求参数，不落库。
16: 
17: ## URL 策略
18: 
19: - 记录 URL 必须是绝对、可解析的 HTTP(S) URL，且 hostname 有效且非空。单标签主机（如 http://localhost）与 IP 字面量均有效；不做 DNS 查询、可达性检查或目标页抓取。
20: - 保存与打开都保留用户提交的原始字符串（不补斜杠、不改大小写、不重写路径）；hostname 由解析结果派生。若 PATCH 更新 URL，必须用新 URL 重新派生 hostname。
21: - 拒绝：缺少 scheme、非 http/https、缺少/非法 hostname、无法解析的字符串；返回 400 invalid_url 且不写入。
22: - 上游 S04 记录点域名正则限制，S02 记录新记录包含派生 hostname；这些是固定来源观察。target 的绝对 HTTP(S) URL 解析、允许单标签 hostname 与保留原始 URL 文本，是本模板的 adjusted 设计，采用上述解析策略。
23: - 保存、打开、抓取三者分离：P0 保存与列表均不请求目标页；打开只产生浏览器导航或 /go 302。
24: 
25: ## API、错误与状态合同
26: 
27: - `GET /api/health` → 200 JSON，含就绪与 schema 版本。
28: - `GET /api/categories` → 200 数组，每项 id、name、count、is_default；count 只计活动记录。
29: - `POST /api/categories` name → 201；重名 409 duplicate_category；空名或超过 120 字符 400 invalid_name。
30: - `PATCH /api/categories/{id}` name → 200；同上校验；默认归类 400 protected_category。`DELETE /api/categories/{id}` → 200；默认归类 400 protected_category；否则事务内把活动与软删记录迁到默认归类。
31: - `GET /api/bookmarks?category=<name|id>&q=<str>&include_trashed=0|1` → 200 数组；默认排序 created_at DESC、id ASC；q 仍仅对标题、hostname、描述做大小写不敏感子串匹配并与 category 叠加；GET 的 category 缺省或空字符串表示全库，非空且未知的归类返回空数组。这是读取过滤语义，不改变保存/移动显式空 category 的 400 invalid_category，也不改变保存省略/null 进入默认归类；不扩为原始 URL 或分类名搜索。
32: - `POST /api/bookmarks` url 必填，title、description、category 可选，allow_duplicate 为 P1；201；category 省略/null 时归入默认「未整理」；显式空字符串或超过 120 字符 400 invalid_category；新名称按 NOCASE 自动创建并复用；非法 URL 400 invalid_url；P1 重复 409 duplicate_url 且附 existing_id。
33: - `GET /api/bookmarks/{id}` 对数据库中仍存在的活动记录及软删除记录一律 200，返回该行的持久状态（含 trashed_at）；仅不存在的 ID 返回 404 not_found。该 GET 只读，不清空 trashed_at、不自动恢复；默认列表及默认计数仍排除软删除记录，include_trashed=1、回收站、分类删除迁移活动与软删记录、恢复与跨重启合同不变。`PATCH` 更新字段；URL 变化时重算 hostname；非法 URL 400 invalid_url，非法归类 400 invalid_category；P1 重复 409 duplicate_url。`POST /api/bookmarks/{id}/move` body category 必填；省略/空/超长 400 invalid_category；新名称自动创建。`DELETE /api/bookmarks/{id}` 软删除 200；`POST /api/bookmarks/{id}/restore` 恢复；P1 同 URL 活动冲突 409 duplicate_url 且不改数据。
34: - `GET /go/{id}` 302，Location 为保存时原始 URL；未知 id 404 not_found。HTML 打开链接使用原始 URL，target=_blank、rel=noopener。
35: - P1：`GET /api/export` Netscape HTML；`POST /api/import` 同格式，返回 imported/skipped。
36: - 错误合同：JSON 失败返回 `{error:{code,message,field}}`；通用 bad_request（畸形/不可解析 JSON，400）、invalid_url、invalid_category、invalid_name、not_found、duplicate_category、protected_category、duplicate_url。校验错误不产生 5xx，不产生部分写入；畸形 JSON 一律 bad_request 且不写。
37: - 机器错误分支范围：`contract_coverage.error_contract` 的 `atlas.bookmark-error-contract.v2` 保持原32条分支和双向映射，专门枚举分类管理及书签保存/移动的分类输入错误（invalid_name、invalid_category），不宣称穷尽产品所有错误。URL 校验、畸形 JSON、未知 ID 等仍受上文完整错误合同约束，分别由既有 A02/A10、A10、A08/A10 的已有断言检查；精确函数/断言和执行前提见本轮 ASSERTION_MAP.md（审阅附带材料）。这是一份静态映射，未执行不称已运行通过。
38: - 状态合同：GET 幂等；写操作事务化；校验失败保持提交前状态；分类与 q 为视图状态；删除与恢复改变 trashed_at 但不删除行。
39: 
40: ## UI/HTML 适配器合同（供真实表单验收与独立浏览器执行者）
41: 
42: - `GET /`：保存表单 `form[action=/bookmarks/new]`（method=post，字段 url/title/description/category；category 预填「未整理」）；`a[data-testid=category-manager]` 指向 /categories；`form[data-testid=category-search-form]` 为 GET /，含 select 或 input name=category（归类名）与 input name=q；记录行 `tr[data-testid=record-row][data-record-id]`；打开链接 `a[data-testid=record-open-link]` 的 href 必须等于保存时原始 URL，target=_blank，rel 含 noopener；每行含 `form[data-testid=record-move-form]`（input record_id、select name=category_id，值为 API 归类 ID）、`form[data-testid=record-delete-form]`（input record_id）；回收站或 `GET /?trash=1` 的软删记录行含 `form[data-testid=record-restore-form]`（input record_id）。
43: - `GET /categories`：`form[data-testid=category-create-form]`（input name）、`form[data-testid=category-rename-form]`（input category_id、name）、`form[data-testid=category-delete-form]`（input category_id）；每个归类行/侧栏计数为 `[data-testid=category-count][data-category-id=...]`，只显示活动记录数；归类名/计数与 JSON 一致。
44: - 表单成功：save 303 到 /?category=...；move 303 到目标归类；delete 303 到 /?trash=1；restore 303 到恢复后归类；category create/rename/delete 303 到 /categories。失败：400/409 渲染当前页，含 `[data-testid=form-error]` 可读消息，保留 url/title/description/category/name/category_id/record_id 中已提交的值，并保留可重新提交的表单；不得 5xx 或写入。
45: - 归类搜索：提交 category 与 q，成功后 URL 与表单同时保留两者；页面显示所选归类、保留的查询和匹配行；同一关键字在两个归类分别得到各自结果；某归类无匹配时显示明确空结果，不是错误。

59: ## 非功能需求
60: 
61: - 离线可用：保存/浏览/检索不依赖外部服务；不设置外部抓取为 P0 要求。
62: - 数据完整性：写事务化；归类删除与恢复保持引用完整；校验失败零写入。
63: - 确定性：排序、错误码、重定向稳定；GET 幂等。
64: - 可访问/可测试：语义化 HTML、表单 label 或 aria、稳定 data-testid；服务端输出 UTF-8。

69:

12: - `bookmarks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, url TEXT NOT NULL, hostname TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NULL, description TEXT NULL, category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id), favicon_url TEXT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, trashed_at INTEGER NULL)`。
13: - 索引：category_id、created_at、hostname；url 不设唯一索引。P1/F14 的重复检测由服务层查询活动记录完成；P0 不启用重复拒绝。
14: - trashed_at 为 NULL 表示活动记录；非 NULL 为软删除。默认列表与计数只统计 trashed_at IS NULL；恢复清空 trashed_at。删除归类在单一事务内把该归类下的活动记录与软删除记录都改到默认归类，因此恢复不会产生无归类记录。
15: - 排序固定为 created_at DESC、id ASC；category 与 q 只作请求参数，不落库。
16: 
17: ## URL 策略
18:

55: - A13 保持原 P1 goal，只修正其页面打开链接断言：按本次 record_id 精确定位 tr[data-testid=record-row][data-record-id]，在该行内读取 a[data-testid=record-open-link] 的 HTML 解码后 href，精确等于提交原始 URL（大小写、路径、查询串、片段均保留），target=_blank，rel 按 token 含 noopener。其他行/注释/隐藏文本不能代替目标行链接，页面不必出现 /go 字符串。A08 另有既有 /go 302、原始 Location、未知 ID404 检查；A13 原先没有自己的302断言，A14/A15 不变。所有测试均不请求或跟随保存的外链。

59: ## 非功能需求
60: 
61: - 离线可用：保存/浏览/检索不依赖外部服务；不设置外部抓取为 P0 要求。
62: - 数据完整性：写事务化；归类删除与恢复保持引用完整；校验失败零写入。
63: - 确定性：排序、错误码、重定向稳定；GET 幂等。
64: - 可访问/可测试：语义化 HTML、表单 label 或 aria、稳定 data-testid；服务端输出 UTF-8。
65: - 单用户本机：无认证；日常 127.0.0.1，0.0.0.0 仅隔离验收网络。
66: - 不设未经验证的时延/吞吐/成本目标；只要求请求可顺序处理。

69: 
70: - 不实现云同步、多设备、协作、分享、浏览器扩展/移动分享目标。
71: - 不保存网页副本、不抓取正文、不做失效链接检测（F17/F18）。
72: - 不引入置顶/归档/多排序/复制 URL/访问计数（F20/F23/F24）。

79: - A04 仅分类管理：HTML create/rename 表单的 name 与 JSON create/rename 的 name 同为归类名称；省略、空字符串、纯空白、121 字符均 400 invalid_name，JSON 显式 null 同样 invalid_name。既有重名 duplicate_category、默认分类 protected_category、删除迁移/恢复均保留。

class _A13TargetLinkParser(HTMLParser):
    """Capture anchors owned by the unique matching record row."""
    def __init__(self, record_id):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.record_id = str(record_id)
        self._table_depth = 0
        self._rows = []
        self.matching_rows = 0
        self.links = []

    def _close_rows_at_or_below(self, table_depth):
        while self._rows and self._rows[-1]['table_depth'] >= table_depth:
            self._rows.pop()

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        tag = tag.lower()
        attrs = {str(key).lower(): ('' if value is None else value) for key, value in attrs}
        if tag == 'table':
            self._table_depth += 1
        elif tag == 'tr':
            # HTML parsers may omit </tr>; a peer <tr> implicitly closes that row.
            # Prune stale peers and malformed descendants before opening the new row.
            self._close_rows_at_or_below(self._table_depth)
            is_target = (
                attrs.get('data-testid') == 'record-row'
                and attrs.get('data-record-id') == self.record_id
            )
            if is_target:
                self.matching_rows += 1
            self._rows.append({'table_depth': self._table_depth, 'target': is_target})
        elif (tag == 'a' and self._rows and self._rows[-1]['target']
              and self._rows[-1]['table_depth'] == self._table_depth
              and attrs.get('data-testid') == 'record-open-link'):
            self.links.append(attrs)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        tag = tag.lower()
        if tag == 'tr':
            self._close_rows_at_or_below(self._table_depth)
        elif tag == 'table':
            self._close_rows_at_or_below(self._table_depth)
            self._table_depth = max(0, self._table_depth - 1)

class _A13TargetLinkParser(HTMLParser):
    """Capture anchors owned by the unique matching record row."""
    def __init__(self, record_id):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.record_id = str(record_id)
        self._table_depth = 0
        self._rows = []
        self.matching_rows = 0
        self.links = []

    def _close_rows_at_or_below(self, table_depth):
        while self._rows and self._rows[-1]['table_depth'] >= table_depth:
            self._rows.pop()

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        tag = tag.lower()
        attrs = {str(key).lower(): ('' if value is None else value) for key, value in attrs}
        if tag == 'table':
            self._table_depth += 1
        elif tag == 'tr':
            # HTML parsers may omit </tr>; a peer <tr> implicitly closes that row.
            # Prune stale peers and malformed descendants before opening the new row.
            self._close_rows_at_or_below(self._table_depth)
            is_target = (
                attrs.get('data-testid') == 'record-row'
                and attrs.get('data-record-id') == self.record_id
            )
            if is_target:
                self.matching_rows += 1
            self._rows.append({'table_depth': self._table_depth, 'target': is_target})
        elif (tag == 'a' and self._rows and self._rows[-1]['target']
              and self._rows[-1]['table_depth'] == self._table_depth
              and attrs.get('data-testid') == 'record-open-link'):
            self.links.append(attrs)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        tag = tag.lower()
        if tag == 'tr':
            self._close_rows_at_or_below(self._table_depth)
        elif tag == 'table':
            self._close_rows_at_or_below(self._table_depth)
            self._table_depth = max(0, self._table_depth - 1)

272:     def _build_url(self, path: Any, params: Any) -> str:
273:         text = '' if path is None else str(path)
274:         parts = urlsplit(text)
275:         if parts.scheme:
276:             if parts.scheme.lower() not in ('http', 'https'):
277:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝非 http/https URL：{_redact_url(text)}')
278:             try:
279:                 absolute_origin = _origin(text)
280:             except ValueError as exc:
281:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝无效 URL：{_redact_url(text)}') from exc
282:             if absolute_origin != self.origin:
283:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝访问目标以外的 URL：{_redact_url(text)}')
284:             url = text
285:         elif parts.netloc:
286:             raise ExternalNavigationBlocked('拒绝协议相对 URL')
287:         elif text.startswith('?'):
288:             url = self.base_url + text
289:         elif text.startswith('/'):
290:             url = self.base_url + text
291:         elif text:
292:             url = self.base_url + '/' + text
293:         else:
294:             url = self.base_url
295:         final = urlsplit(url)
296:         query = final.query
297:         if params:
298:             pairs = parse_qsl(query, keep_blank_values=True)
299:             if isinstance(params, Mapping):
300:                 pairs.extend(params.items())
301:             else:
302:                 pairs.extend(params)
303:             query = urlencode(pairs, doseq=True)
304:         return urlunsplit((final.scheme, final.netloc, final.path, query, ''))
305: 
306:     def request(self, method: str, path: str = '', *, params: Any = None, headers: Any = None,
307:                 json: Any = None, data: Any = None, form: Any = None, accept: str | None = None,
308:                 follow_redirects: bool | None = None, timeout: float | None = None,
309:                 max_redirects: int = 5) -> HttpResponse:
310:         current_method = str(method).upper()
311:         if current_method not in ('GET', 'POST', 'PATCH', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'):
312:             raise ValueError('不支持的 HTTP 方法')
313:         body_kinds = (json is not None, data is not None, form is not None)
314:         if sum(1 for flag in body_kinds if flag) > 1:
315:             raise ValueError('json、data 与 form 只能提供一个')
316:         body: bytes | None = None
317:         content_type: str | None = None
318:         if json is not None:
319:             body = _json.dumps(json, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')
320:             content_type = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
321:         elif form is not None:
322:             pairs = form.items() if isinstance(form, Mapping) else form
323:             body = urlencode(list(pairs), doseq=True).encode('utf-8')
324:             content_type = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=utf-8'
325:         elif data is not None:
326:             if isinstance(data, str):
327:                 body = data.encode('utf-8')
328:             elif isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
329:                 body = bytes(data)
330:             else:
331:                 raise TypeError('data 必须是 str 或 bytes')
332:         prepared = {str(key): str(value) for key, value in (headers or {}).items()}
333:         for key in prepared:
334:             if key.lower() in ('authorization', 'proxy-authorization'):
335:                 raise ValueError('目标不需要认证，不支持认证头')
336:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'Accept'):
337:             prepared['Accept'] = accept or 'application/json'
338:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'User-Agent'):
339:             prepared['User-Agent'] = 'atlas-acceptance/1.0'
340:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'Accept-Encoding'):
341:             prepared['Accept-Encoding'] = 'identity'
342:         if body is not None and content_type and not _has_header(prepared, 'Content-Type'):
343:             prepared['Content-Type'] = content_type
344:         follow = self.follow_redirects if follow_redirects is None else bool(follow_redirects)
345:         resolved_timeout = self.timeout if timeout is None else float(timeout)
346:         current_url = self._build_url(path, params)
347:         current_body = body
348:         current_headers = prepared
349:         redirects = 0
350:         while True:
351:             request = Request(
352:                 current_url,
353:                 data=current_body if current_method not in ('GET', 'HEAD') else None,
354:                 headers=current_headers,
355:                 method=current_method,
356:             )
357:             started = time.monotonic()
358:             try:
359:                 with self._opener.open(request, timeout=resolved_timeout) as raw:
360:                     status = int(getattr(raw, 'status', raw.getcode()))
361:                     response_headers = raw.headers
362:                     response_body = raw.read()
363:             except HTTPError as exc:
364:                 status = int(exc.code)
365:                 response_headers = exc.headers if exc.headers is not None else {}
366:                 try:
367:                     response_body = exc.read()
368:                 except Exception:
369:                     response_body = b''
370:                 finally:
371:                     try:
372:                         exc.close()
373:                     except Exception:
374:                         pass
375:             except (URLError, HTTPException, TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
376:                 reason = getattr(exc, 'reason', exc)
377:                 raise HttpRequestError(
378:                     f'{current_method} {_redact_url(current_url)} 请求失败：{_redact_text(reason, 300)}'
379:                 ) from exc
380:             elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
381:             response = HttpResponse(status, response_headers, response_body, current_method, current_url, elapsed)
382:             if not follow or status not in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
383:                 return response
384:             location = response.location
385:             if not location:
386:                 return response
387:             if redirects >= max_redirects:
388:                 raise HttpRequestError(f'重定向次数超过 {max_redirects}：{_redact_url(current_url)}')
389:             redirects += 1
390:             next_url = urljoin(current_url, location.strip())
391:             try:
392:                 next_origin = _origin(next_url)
393:             except ValueError as exc:
394:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝重定向到无效目标：{_redact_url(next_url)}') from exc
395:             if next_origin != self.origin:
396:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝跨源重定向：{_redact_url(next_url)}')
397:             if status == 303 or (status in (301, 302) and current_method == 'POST'):
398:                 current_method = 'GET'
399:                 current_body = None
400:                 current_headers = {
401:                     key: value for key, value in current_headers.items()
402:                     if key.lower() not in ('content-type', 'content-length')
403:                 }
404:             current_url = next_url
405:

485:     deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, float(timeout))
486:     last_error = '尚未收到健康响应'
487:     while True:
488:         if proc is not None and proc.poll() is not None:

492:         remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()

499:                 except Exception as exc:
500:                     last_error = f'健康检查返回非 JSON：{_redact_text(exc, 200)}'
501:                 else:

509:         except AppStartError:
510:             raise
511:         except Exception as exc:
512:             last_error = _redact_text(exc, 300)
513:         if time.monotonic() >= deadline:

515:         time.sleep(min(0.2, max(0.02, deadline - time.monotonic())))
516:     tail = _tail(getattr(proc, 'log_path', None)) if proc is not None else ''
517:     message = f'等待 {_redact_url(base)}/api/health 就绪超时：{last_error}'
518:     if tail:

675:         ]
676:         child_env = os.environ.copy()
677:         if env:
678:             child_env.update({str(name): str(value) for name, value in env.items()})
679:         child_env['PYTHONUNBUFFERED'] = '1'
680:         child_env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'

683:             'http_proxy', 'https_proxy', 'all_proxy', 'no_proxy',

687:             proc = AppProcess(
688:                 command,
689:                 base_url=f'http://127.0.0.1:{numeric_port}',
690:                 scratch_dir=scratch,
691:                 app_root=root,
692:                 port=numeric_port,
693:                 log_path=log_path,
694:                 log_handle=log_handle,
695:                 cwd=root,
696:                 env=child_env,
697:                 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
698:                 stdout=log_handle,
699:                 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,

297:         if params:
298:             pairs = parse_qsl(query, keep_blank_values=True)
299:             if isinstance(params, Mapping):
300:                 pairs.extend(params.items())

306:     def request(self, method: str, path: str = '', *, params: Any = None, headers: Any = None,
307:                 json: Any = None, data: Any = None, form: Any = None, accept: str | None = None,
308:                 follow_redirects: bool | None = None, timeout: float | None = None,
309:                 max_redirects: int = 5) -> HttpResponse:
310:         current_method = str(method).upper()
311:         if current_method not in ('GET', 'POST', 'PATCH', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'):
312:             raise ValueError('不支持的 HTTP 方法')
313:         body_kinds = (json is not None, data is not None, form is not None)
314:         if sum(1 for flag in body_kinds if flag) > 1:
315:             raise ValueError('json、data 与 form 只能提供一个')
316:         body: bytes | None = None
317:         content_type: str | None = None
318:         if json is not None:
319:             body = _json.dumps(json, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')
320:             content_type = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
321:         elif form is not None:
322:             pairs = form.items() if isinstance(form, Mapping) else form
323:             body = urlencode(list(pairs), doseq=True).encode('utf-8')
324:             content_type = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=utf-8'
325:         elif data is not None:
326:             if isinstance(data, str):
327:                 body = data.encode('utf-8')
328:             elif isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
329:                 body = bytes(data)
330:             else:
331:                 raise TypeError('data 必须是 str 或 bytes')
332:         prepared = {str(key): str(value) for key, value in (headers or {}).items()}
333:         for key in prepared:
334:             if key.lower() in ('authorization', 'proxy-authorization'):
335:                 raise ValueError('目标不需要认证，不支持认证头')
336:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'Accept'):
337:             prepared['Accept'] = accept or 'application/json'
338:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'User-Agent'):
339:             prepared['User-Agent'] = 'atlas-acceptance/1.0'
340:         if not _has_header(prepared, 'Accept-Encoding'):
341:             prepared['Accept-Encoding'] = 'identity'
342:         if body is not None and content_type and not _has_header(prepared, 'Content-Type'):
343:             prepared['Content-Type'] = content_type
344:         follow = self.follow_redirects if follow_redirects is None else bool(follow_redirects)
345:         resolved_timeout = self.timeout if timeout is None else float(timeout)
346:         current_url = self._build_url(path, params)
347:         current_body = body
348:         current_headers = prepared
349:         redirects = 0
350:         while True:
351:             request = Request(
352:                 current_url,
353:                 data=current_body if current_method not in ('GET', 'HEAD') else None,
354:                 headers=current_headers,
355:                 method=current_method,
356:             )
357:             started = time.monotonic()
358:             try:
359:                 with self._opener.open(request, timeout=resolved_timeout) as raw:
360:                     status = int(getattr(raw, 'status', raw.getcode()))
361:                     response_headers = raw.headers
362:                     response_body = raw.read()
363:             except HTTPError as exc:
364:                 status = int(exc.code)
365:                 response_headers = exc.headers if exc.headers is not None else {}
366:                 try:
367:                     response_body = exc.read()
368:                 except Exception:
369:                     response_body = b''
370:                 finally:
371:                     try:
372:                         exc.close()
373:                     except Exception:
374:                         pass
375:             except (URLError, HTTPException, TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError) as exc:
376:                 reason = getattr(exc, 'reason', exc)
377:                 raise HttpRequestError(
378:                     f'{current_method} {_redact_url(current_url)} 请求失败：{_redact_text(reason, 300)}'
379:                 ) from exc
380:             elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
381:             response = HttpResponse(status, response_headers, response_body, current_method, current_url, elapsed)
382:             if not follow or status not in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
383:                 return response
384:             location = response.location
385:             if not location:
386:                 return response
387:             if redirects >= max_redirects:
388:                 raise HttpRequestError(f'重定向次数超过 {max_redirects}：{_redact_url(current_url)}')
389:             redirects += 1
390:             next_url = urljoin(current_url, location.strip())
391:             try:
392:                 next_origin = _origin(next_url)
393:             except ValueError as exc:
394:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝重定向到无效目标：{_redact_url(next_url)}') from exc
395:             if next_origin != self.origin:
396:                 raise ExternalNavigationBlocked(f'拒绝跨源重定向：{_redact_url(next_url)}')
397:             if status == 303 or (status in (301, 302) and current_method == 'POST'):
398:                 current_method = 'GET'
399:                 current_body = None
400:                 current_headers = {
401:                     key: value for key, value in current_headers.items()
402:                     if key.lower() not in ('content-type', 'content-length')
403:                 }
404:             current_url = next_url

472:     try:
473:         with open(str(path), 'rb') as handle:

475:             position = handle.tell()
476:             handle.seek(max(0, position - limit))

483: def wait_health(base_url: str, timeout: float = 30.0, proc: AppProcess | None = None) -> bool:
484:     base = _normalize_base_url(base_url)
485:     deadline = time.monotonic() + max(0.0, float(timeout))
486:     last_error = '尚未收到健康响应'
487:     while True:
488:         if proc is not None and proc.poll() is not None:
489:             tail = _tail(getattr(proc, 'log_path', None))
490:             suffix = f'；日志尾部：{tail}' if tail else ''
491:             raise AppStartError(f'应用进程在就绪前退出（code={proc.returncode}）{suffix}')
492:         remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
493:         try:
494:             client = HttpClient(base, timeout=max(0.5, min(2.0, remaining if remaining > 0 else 0.5)))
495:             response = client.get(HEALTH_PATH)
496:             if response.status == 200:
497:                 try:
498:                     payload = response.json()
499:                 except Exception as exc:
500:                     last_error = f'健康检查返回非 JSON：{_redact_text(exc, 200)}'
501:                 else:
502:                     if isinstance(payload, dict):
503:                         return True
504:                     last_error = '健康检查 JSON 不是对象'
505:             elif response.status in (401, 403):
506:                 raise AppStartError('目标要求认证，当前验收适配器不支持认证')
507:             else:
508:                 last_error = f'健康检查返回 HTTP {response.status}'
509:         except AppStartError:
510:             raise
511:         except Exception as exc:
512:             last_error = _redact_text(exc, 300)
513:         if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
514:             break
515:         time.sleep(min(0.2, max(0.02, deadline - time.monotonic())))
516:     tail = _tail(getattr(proc, 'log_path', None)) if proc is not None else ''
517:     message = f'等待 {_redact_url(base)}/api/health 就绪超时：{last_error}'
518:     if tail:
519:         message += f'；日志尾部：{tail}'
520:     raise AppStartError(message)

605: def stop_app(proc: Any, timeout: float = 10.0) -> None:
606:     if proc is None:

608:     try:
609:         if proc.poll() is None:
610:             _send_signal(proc, signal.SIGTERM)
611:             try:
612:                 proc.wait(timeout=float(timeout))
613:             except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
614:                 _send_signal(proc, getattr(signal, 'SIGKILL', signal.SIGTERM))
615:                 try:
616:                     proc.wait(timeout=5.0)
617:                 except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError):
618:                     pass
619:         else:
620:             try:
621:                 proc.wait(timeout=1.0)
622:             except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError):
623:                 pass
624:     finally:
625:         _close_log(proc)
626:         _forget_active(proc)

636: def launch_app(app_root: str, data_dir: str, port: int, *, instance_dir: str | None = None,
637:                fresh: bool = False, timeout: float = 30.0,
638:                env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> AppProcess:
639:     root, script = _prepare_app_root(app_root)
640:     data_root = _ensure_directory(data_dir, '--data-dir')
641:     try:
642:         numeric_port = int(port)
643:     except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
644:         raise AppStartError('port 必须是整数') from exc
645:     if numeric_port <= 0:
646:         numeric_port = free_port()
647:     if numeric_port < 1 or numeric_port > 65535:
648:         raise AppStartError('port 超出范围')
649:     instances_root = _ensure_directory(os.path.join(data_root, 'instances'), '实例根目录')
650:     key = (root, data_root)
651:     with _REGISTRY_LOCK:
652:         previous = _ACTIVE_BY_KEY.get(key)
653:         if previous is not None and previous.poll() is None:
654:             raise AppStartError('该 data_dir 已有运行中的实例，请先调用 stop_app')
655:         if previous is not None:
656:             _close_log(previous)
657:             _ACTIVE_BY_KEY.pop(key, None)
658:         if instance_dir is not None and fresh:
659:             raise AppStartError('instance_dir 与 fresh 不能同时使用')
660:         if instance_dir is not None:
661:             scratch = _validate_instance(instances_root, instance_dir)
662:         elif fresh or key not in _SCRATCH_BY_KEY or not os.path.isdir(_SCRATCH_BY_KEY[key]):
663:             scratch = _new_instance(instances_root)
664:         else:
665:             scratch = _SCRATCH_BY_KEY[key]
666:         _SCRATCH_BY_KEY[key] = scratch
667:         logs_dir = _ensure_directory(os.path.join(scratch, 'logs'), '实例日志目录')
668:         log_path = os.path.join(logs_dir, f'app-{int(time.time() * 1000)}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.log')
669:         log_handle = open(log_path, 'ab', buffering=0)
670:         command = [
671:             sys.executable or 'python3', script,
672:             '--host', '127.0.0.1',
673:             '--port', str(numeric_port),
674:             '--data-dir', scratch,
675:         ]
676:         child_env = os.environ.copy()
677:         if env:
678:             child_env.update({str(name): str(value) for name, value in env.items()})
679:         child_env['PYTHONUNBUFFERED'] = '1'
680:         child_env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
681:         for proxy_name in (
682:             'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'ALL_PROXY', 'NO_PROXY',
683:             'http_proxy', 'https_proxy', 'all_proxy', 'no_proxy',
684:         ):
685:             child_env.pop(proxy_name, None)
686:         try:
687:             proc = AppProcess(
688:                 command,
689:                 base_url=f'http://127.0.0.1:{numeric_port}',
690:                 scratch_dir=scratch,
691:                 app_root=root,
692:                 port=numeric_port,
693:                 log_path=log_path,
694:                 log_handle=log_handle,
695:                 cwd=root,
696:                 env=child_env,
697:                 stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
698:                 stdout=log_handle,
699:                 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
700:                 close_fds=True,
701:                 start_new_session=(os.name == 'posix'),
702:             )
703:         except OSError as exc:
704:             log_handle.close()
705:             _SCRATCH_BY_KEY.pop(key, None)
706:             raise AppStartError('无法启动应用进程') from exc
707:         except Exception:
708:             log_handle.close()
709:             _SCRATCH_BY_KEY.pop(key, None)
710:             raise
711:         _ACTIVE_BY_KEY[key] = proc
712:     try:
713:         wait_health(proc.base_url, timeout=timeout, proc=proc)
714:     except AppStartError as exc:
715:         stop_app(proc)
716:         with _REGISTRY_LOCK:
717:             _SCRATCH_BY_KEY.pop(key, None)
718:         raise AppStartError(f'{exc}；启动日志：{log_path}') from exc
719:     except BaseException:
720:         stop_app(proc)
721:         raise
722:     return proc

797:         if not clean_id:
798:             clean_id = f'assertion-{index}'

515: def _category_values_in_html(doc):
516:     values = set()
517:     for form in doc.forms:
518:         for select in form.selects:
519:             if select.name != 'category':
520:                 continue
521:             for option in select.options:
522:                 value = option.resolved_value()
523:                 if value:
524:                     values.add(value)
525:                 text = option.text.strip()
526:                 if text:
527:                     values.add(text)
528:     for anchor in doc.anchors:
529:         try:
530:             parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(anchor.href)
531:         except ValueError:
532:             continue
533:         for key, value in urllib.parse.parse_qsl(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True):
534:             if key == 'category' and value:
535:                 values.add(value)
536:     return values

165: class _HtmlReader(HTMLParser):
166:     def __init__(self):
167:         super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
168:         self.doc = _Document()
169:         self._form = None
170:         self._select = None
171:         self._option = None
172:         self._textarea = None
173:         self._anchor = None
174:         self._row = None
175:         self._testid_stack = []
176: 
177:     def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
178:         tag = tag.lower()
179:         attributes = {
180:             str(key).lower(): ('' if value is None else value)
181:             for key, value in attrs
182:         }
183:         self.doc.start_tags.append((tag, attributes))
184:         testid = attributes.get('data-testid') or ''
185:         if testid:
186:             entry = {'tag': tag, 'attrs': attributes, 'text': ''}
187:             self.doc.testids.append(entry)
188:             self._testid_stack.append((tag, entry))
189:         if tag == 'form':
190:             self._finish_form()
191:             self._form = _Form(attributes)
192:         elif tag == 'input':
193:             if self._form is not None:
194:                 self._form.fields.append(_Field(attributes))
195:         elif tag == 'select':
196:             self._finish_select()
197:             if self._form is not None:
198:                 self._select = _Select(attributes)
199:         elif tag == 'option':
200:             self._finish_option()
201:             if self._select is not None:
202:                 self._option = _Option(attributes)
203:         elif tag == 'textarea':
204:             self._finish_textarea()
205:             if self._form is not None:
206:                 self._textarea = _Textarea(attributes)
207:         elif tag == 'a':
208:             self._finish_anchor()
209:             self._anchor = _Anchor(attributes)
210:         elif tag == 'tr' and testid == 'record-row':
211:             self._finish_row()
212:             self._row = _Row(attributes)
213: 
214:     def handle_data(self, data):
215:         if not data:
216:             return
217:         self.doc.text += data
218:         if self._row is not None:
219:             self._row.text += data
220:         if self._anchor is not None:
221:             self._anchor.text += data
222:         if self._option is not None:
223:             self._option.text += data
224:         if self._textarea is not None:
225:             self._textarea.text += data
226:         for _, entry in self._testid_stack:
227:             entry['text'] += data
228: 
229:     def handle_endtag(self, tag):
230:         tag = tag.lower()
231:         if tag == 'a':
232:             self._finish_anchor()
233:         elif tag == 'option':
234:             self._finish_option()
235:         elif tag == 'select':
236:             self._finish_select()
237:         elif tag == 'textarea':
238:             self._finish_textarea()
239:         elif tag == 'form':
240:             self._finish_form()
241:         elif tag == 'tr':
242:             self._finish_row()
243:         if self._testid_stack and self._testid_stack[-1][0] == tag:
244:             self._testid_stack.pop()
245: 
246:     def _finish_option(self):
247:         if self._option is None:
248:             return
249:         option = self._option
250:         self._option = None
251:         if self._select is not None:
252:             self._select.options.append(option)
253: 
254:     def _finish_select(self):
255:         self._finish_option()
256:         if self._select is None:
257:             return
258:         select = self._select
259:         self._select = None
260:         if self._form is not None:
261:             self._form.selects.append(select)
262: 
263:     def _finish_textarea(self):
264:         if self._textarea is None:
265:             return
266:         textarea = self._textarea
267:         self._textarea = None
268:         if self._form is not None:
269:             self._form.textareas.append(textarea)
270: 
271:     def _finish_anchor(self):
272:         if self._anchor is None:
273:             return
274:         anchor = self._anchor
275:         self._anchor = None
276:         self.doc.anchors.append(anchor)
277:         if self._row is not None:
278:             self._row.anchors.append(anchor)
279: 
280:     def _finish_row(self):
281:         if self._row is None:
282:             return
283:         row = self._row
284:         self._row = None
285:         self.doc.rows.append(row)
286: 
287:     def _finish_form(self):
288:         self._finish_select()
289:         self._finish_textarea()
290:         if self._form is None:
291:             return
292:         form = self._form
293:         self._form = None
294:         self.doc.forms.append(form)
295: 
296:     def finalize(self):
297:         self._finish_anchor()
298:         self._finish_row()
299:         self._finish_form()
300:

306:     reader.finalize()
307:     return reader.doc

417: def _category_name(record, categories):
418:     if not isinstance(record, dict):
419:         return None
420:     names = _category_names(categories)
421:     by_id = {}
422:     for item in categories:
423:         if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get('id') is not None and item.get('name') is not None:
424:             by_id[str(item['id'])] = str(item['name'])
425:     for key in ('category', 'category_name', 'categoryName'):
426:         value = record.get(key)
427:         if isinstance(value, str):
428:             if value in names:
429:                 return value
430:             if value in by_id:
431:                 return by_id[value]
432:             return value
433:         if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('name') is not None:
434:             return str(value['name'])
435:     for key in ('category_id', 'categoryId'):
436:         value = record.get(key)
437:         if value is not None and str(value) in by_id:
438:             return by_id[str(value)]

450: def _form_fields(form, overrides=None, omit=()):
451:     fields = {}
452:     for field in form.fields:
453:         name = field.name
454:         if not name:
455:             continue
456:         if field.type in ('submit', 'button', 'reset', 'file', 'image'):
457:             continue
458:         if field.type in ('checkbox', 'radio') and not field.checked:
459:             continue
460:         fields[name] = field.value
461:     for select in form.selects:
462:         if select.name:
463:             fields[select.name] = select.selected_value()
464:     for textarea in form.textareas:
465:         if textarea.name:
466:             fields[textarea.name] = textarea.text
467:     if overrides:
468:         for key, value in overrides.items():
469:             fields[str(key)] = str(value)
470:     for name in omit:
471:         fields.pop(name, None)
472:     return fields

515: def _category_values_in_html(doc):
516:     values = set()
517:     for form in doc.forms:
518:         for select in form.selects:
519:             if select.name != 'category':
520:                 continue
521:             for option in select.options:
522:                 value = option.resolved_value()
523:                 if value:
524:                     values.add(value)
525:                 text = option.text.strip()
526:                 if text:
527:                     values.add(text)
528:     for anchor in doc.anchors:
529:         try:
530:             parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(anchor.href)
531:         except ValueError:
532:             continue
533:         for key, value in urllib.parse.parse_qsl(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True):
534:             if key == 'category' and value:
535:                 values.add(value)
536:     return values
